evidence_series: daily net excess return over the TAIEX total-return index; strategy returns are official-event adjusted prices after project costs
benchmark: TAIEX total-return index (MI_INDEX 發行量加權股價報酬指數)

bootstrap.method: moving block bootstrap, percentile interval of the annualized Sharpe

sharpe: annualized with 252 sessions, no risk-free rate

deflated_sharpe.trial_count_note: known searches only: a lower bound, so the deflation is if anything too small

regimes.definition: previous-session TAIEX price index above its 200-session average = bull

gates: g1 net and excess Sharpe > 0 at 2x costs
g4 top-5 assets and best-5%-days profit share < 50 % (literal reading)
g5 bull and bear excess not both negative and each regime has >= 60 sessions

execution_audit.material: unfillable orders > 1% of orders or value above the 5 % cap > 5% of order value
execution_audit.scope: flags only; no partial or unfilled fills were simulated, so strict executability is NOT verified
